en.hero_h1: Cloud services that cost nothing while nobody uses them.
en.hero_p: AWS's "serverless" databases, caches and schedulers still bill every hour, and so do the apps you host. IdleFree rebuilds them on Lambda, S3 and DynamoDB. You pay per request, and nothing when it's quiet.
en.install_p: every driver and server on PyPI
en.infra_p: An AWS service, rebuilt. Same client, same API; the real service is one import away.
en.app_p: An application, unchanged, on Lambda. Its own CLI, API and UI; only the host changes.

zh.hero_h1: 没人用的时候，一分钱都不花的云服务。
zh.hero_p: AWS 的 “serverless” 数据库、缓存和调度服务，没人用也按小时收费，你自己托管的应用也一样。IdleFree 把它们重建在 Lambda、S3 和 DynamoDB 上。按请求付费，没人用就不花钱。
zh.install_p: 所有客户端和服务端都在 PyPI 上
zh.code_p: 源码、测试和兼容性报告
zh.infra_p: 重建一个 AWS 服务。同样的客户端、同样的 API；改一行 import 就回到真服务。
zh.app_p: 现成的应用，代码不改，跑在 Lambda 上。带着它自己的命令行、API 和界面，只换宿主。
